tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search every garment Levels sells by category, brand, trade, colour, fabric, budget and more. Returns how many match, how they spread, and the best 15 with prices before a logo and links.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The facts of one garment: brand, fabric, fit, sizes, colours, what it suits, its price before a logo and its link.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: A real price from the site's own pricing engine for one garment at a quantity, with one logo on the left chest at a typical size. The product page prices the customer's real artwork exactly.

tools.name: get_business_facts
tools.description: Timings, delivery, minimums, set-up, decoration methods, samples, returns and contact details, as the site states them.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: The link that takes the customer to a garment to add their logo, choose sizes and pay, and the link to ask for a sample first. Give these to the customer; nothing is ordered until they finish it.
